paper.title: Approaching the Thermodynamic Limit with Neural-Network Quantum States
paper.authors: Luciano Loris Viteritti, Riccardo Rende, Subir Sachdev, Giuseppe Carleo

results.system_description: 18x18 triangular lattice, periodic along both primitive vectors; J = 1; S = sigma/2; total Sz = 0
results.variant: spatial-attention ViT with translational and C6v symmetries
results.source_location: Table I, p. 3 (row 18 × 18, Ansatz ViT, 'This work')
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the symmetrized ViT wavefunction on the periodic L × L triangular cluster; the 'Zero Variance' rows of the same table are extrapolations and excluded.
results.notes: Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending. Audit 2026-10-15: the energy token, original NQS attribution and variational status were checked, but the exact spin-sector assignment in benchmark_id was not independently confirmed from the cited paper.
